description: The plot illustrates how Micro F1 (%) changes for KnowPrompt across four relation extraction datasets as the number of training samples generated by LLMs varies. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and uses four discrete category ticks at K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64 (no units shown, categorical spacing). The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from the low 20s up to just above 50, with labeled ticks at regular 5-point intervals (25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50). Four solid lines are shown: TACRED is a blue line with circular markers, rising from about 22.4 at K=8 to ~27.9 at K=16 and ~30.3 at K=32, then slightly decreasing to ~29.3 at K=64; TACRED-Revisit is an orange line with upward-triangle markers, increasing from ~23.0 at K=8 to ~29.2 at K=16 and ~31.1 at K=32, then decreasing to ~29.9 at K=64; Re-TACRED is a green line with diamond markers, increasing from ~34.8 at K=8 to ~40.2 at K=16 and peaking around ~50.7 at K=32, then declining to ~47.9 at K=64; SemEval is a red line with star markers, increasing steadily from ~42.0 at K=8 to ~45.0 at K=16, ~47.6 at K=32, and ~51.8 at K=64.
